overview_description.description: First Abu Dhabi Bank provides a diverse array of banking services, catering to both individual and corporate clients. The bank offers personal banking products such as credit cards, loans, and mortgages, along with Islamic banking solutions designed to meet various customer needs. Additionally, it delivers corporate banking services, including investment banking and treasury solutions, aimed at supporting businesses in their financial operations. First Abu Dhabi Bank maintains a strong focus on customer support, offering multiple channels for assistance and information. The bank emphasizes accessibility and convenience in its service delivery, ensuring clients can easily manage their banking needs.

identifier.value: Islamic Banking

product.description: Sharia-compliant personal, business, investment, and elite banking services, including accounts, cards, personal finance, home finance, auto finance, trade facilities, and investment deposits.

identifier.value: Global Markets

product.description: Financial markets products and services across asset classes, supported by market expertise, technology, and research covering foreign exchange, interest rates, credit, commodities, and macroeconomic developments.

identifier.value: Global Corporate Finance

product.name: Global Corporate Finance
product.description: Investment banking services for sourcing, structuring, distributing, and executing financing and investment opportunities in local and international markets.

identifier.value: International Transaction Banking

product.description: Cross-border banking services that support domestic and international payments, trade transactions, cash management, accounts, and related corporate banking operations.
